fixtures.description: Slow congestion: each short interval looks stationary, but each completed rolling window has meaningful cumulative displacement.

A.payable: All otherwise valid seconds remain payable because each rolling-window displacement is above RD_MIN_DISPLACEMENT_M.
A.excluded: Only pre-existing signal/window/area exclusions, if any; none in this fixture.

B.payable: The first min(total short-candidate seconds, CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS) remain payable.
B.excluded: Short-candidate seconds strictly above CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS become stationary_subwindow_budget_exceeded.
B.explanation: shows the underpayment trade-off if honest congestion exhausts the cumulative budget

C.payable: All otherwise valid seconds are gross-payable under the existing classifier.
C.excluded: Only pre-existing reasons; none in this fixture.
C.held: All gross-payable seconds in the selected hold scope if the inclusive seconds/count trigger fires; otherwise 0.
C.review: true only when the trigger fires and MNY-08A/B exists

fixtures.description: Twenty-four cycles of a 4:59 stop followed by a repositioning hop beyond the stay radius; total duration is two hours.

A.payable: Hop seconds plus the one whole-scope grace and any windows not yet confirmed by RD_CONFIRM_WINDOWS.
A.excluded: Confirmed below/equal-displacement stop windows after grace are stationary_rolling_displacement.
A.explanation: must not remain fully payable under a completed option-A parameter set

B.payable: Hop seconds plus the first CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS of short-stop candidate time.
B.excluded: All candidate seconds strictly above the cumulative budget are stationary_subwindow_budget_exceeded.
B.explanation: the repositioning hops do not replenish the budget

C.payable: Existing-classifier gross payable time remains unchanged.
C.excluded: No new stationary exclusion is created by option C.
C.held: All otherwise payable seconds in the selected scope once the inclusive trigger fires.
C.explanation: cannot close RM2 until MNY-08A/B supplies the authoritative hold

fixtures.description: One uninterrupted parked episode that is at or above the existing stationary-window threshold.

A.excluded: Episode seconds after the one whole-scope grace are stationary_rolling_displacement.
A.explanation: existing long-stay behavior remains bounded by one grace budget

B.excluded: Episode seconds after grace are stationary; the sub-window budget is not used for a long stay.

C.excluded: Episode seconds after grace are stationary under the existing classifier.
C.held: 0 unless a separately approved option-C rule includes long-stay evidence; this packet does not.
C.explanation: option C is scoped to the open short-stay hole, not a second long-stay penalty

fixtures.description: Two genuine brief stops embedded in otherwise moving, valid campaign time.

A.payable: All seconds remain payable because cumulative rolling displacement stays above threshold.
A.explanation: brief stops do not erase meaninful rolling movement

B.payable: All seconds remain payable while the combined brief-stop time is within CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS.
B.excluded: Only the portion strictly above the budget, if the owner selects a smaller budget.
B.explanation: budget makes the honest-stop allowance explicit

C.payable: All seconds are gross-payable unless the owner-selected inclusive trigger is reached.
C.held: 0 below the trigger; otherwise the selected scope is held for review.
C.explanation: false-positive behavior is visible rather than silently decided
